verdict.rationale: Ollama ships a desktop chat app and integrations with coding agents, so an AI document workspace is a fair question for this kind of product. However, no evidence shows an integrated workspace where an agent drafts and edits documents with automatic saving. Its connections to Claude Code, Codex, and VS Code Chat are integrations with other tools, not its own document-editing capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an AI agent draft and edit documents in an integrated workspace with changes saved automatically
